title: 污染土壤洗滌
summary: 本課以「追蹤污染物在粗土、細泥與洗液間的分配以評估土壤洗滌」為主軸，依序處理場址分區與代表樣本、乾基污染庫存、洗液負荷與水循環、含水與產品重量、泵送與洗滌能耗。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Evaluate soil washing by following contamination among coarse soil, fines and wash water, progressing through Site zones and representative samples, Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Wash-water load and recycle, Moisture and product mass, Pumping and washing energy. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.title: 乾基污染庫存：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Dry-basis contaminant inventory: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 乾基污染庫存 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dry-basis contaminant inventory and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進料污染總量需結合乾重和分析濃度，含水變化不能冒充去污。 先把濕土換成乾重，再乘相同乾基分析濃度；mg 污染物最後換算成 kg，避免含水率假造移除量。
steps.instructionEn: Initial contaminant inventory requires dry mass and concentration; moisture changes cannot stand in for cleanup. Convert wet soil to dry mass before multiplying by matching dry-basis concentration, then convert pollutant mg to kg to avoid moisture-driven apparent removal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土壤濕重 mw=1000 kg；濕基水分 w=0.30；乾基濃度 Cd=200 mg/kg dry。公式 mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6，計算得 0.14 kg contaminant。適用邊界：含水率和濃度代表同批土壤，未含洗液或其他出口，分析濃度不是總土壤成分百分比。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet soil mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30; dry-basis concentration Cd=200 mg/kg dry. Formula mp=mw*(1-w)*Cd/1e6 gives 0.14 kg contaminant. Applicability: Moisture and concentration represent the same soil batch; wash water and other outlets are excluded, and analytical concentration is not bulk component percentage.
steps.failure: 將乾基濃度乘濕重會高估污染庫存，且使不同含水批次不可比。 在「乾基污染庫存」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying dry-basis concentration by wet mass overstates inventory and prevents fair comparison across moisture states. Mark where this error can enter the Dry-basis contaminant inventory flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「乾基污染庫存」，同步取含水與化學分析樣，核對乾基標記及 mg/kg 單位，再與全部固液出口比對。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Dry-basis contaminant inventory, Collect moisture and chemical samples together, verify dry-basis labels and mg/kg units and reconcile all solid and liquid outlets. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.instruction: 將洗後粗料與細泥同時化驗，檢查污染物是否被集中到需要後續處理的物流。 洗滌把污染物集中到細粒或水相，清潔粗料改善須以所有出口的質量收支支持。
